_schema.generated: ISO timestamp of the daily refresh; the page shows it and flags >=2d stale
_schema.tickers: map of ticker id -> array of news items, any order (the page sorts newest-first and filters to the last 7 days)

item.date: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the news broke (the page joins this to own price data for the 1d move)
item.headline: one line, what happened
item.why: optional, one line on why it matters for this name
item.src: publication or filing the item came from - required for anything asserted as fact

META.headline: Meta launches Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its most capable AI models to date
META.why: First frontier-class model release positions Meta to compete directly with OpenAI and Anthropic, with flagship model gated behind a new paid Muse Code subscription

META.headline: Cantor Fitzgerald cuts Meta price target to $840 from $860
META.why: Trim from a bullish shop on the same day as the Muse Wonder launch shows mixed near-term sentiment heading into Q3 earnings

META.headline: Meta bars ByteDance/TikTok from buying ads on Facebook and Instagram in seven countries
META.why: Escalates the Meta-TikTok rivalry over users and ad dollars, cutting off a competitor's access to Meta's ad inventory in key markets including the US

META.headline: Wells Fargo raises Meta price target to $1,000 from $796, keeps Overweight
META.why: Sizable bullish target hike signals growing Street conviction on Meta's AI-driven growth ahead of Q3 earnings
META.src: Wells Fargo research note (via Defense World/Benzinga)

NVDA.headline: Nvidia opens Vera Rubin rack designs to Open Compute Project, unveils pluggable optics with Cisco
NVDA.why: Pushes Nvidia's next-gen AI-factory architecture toward an open industry standard, reinforcing its ecosystem lock-in ahead of Rubin ramp

NVDA.headline: Nvidia in talks to acquire or raise its stake in AI startup Reflection AI, FT reports
NVDA.why: M&A optionality in open-weight AI models could extend Nvidia's software/model reach beyond chips

NVDA.headline: Nvidia-backed Firmus withdraws $5.5B Australian IPO citing weak investor demand
NVDA.why: Signals investor pushback on AI data-center valuations within Nvidia's own backed-company ecosystem

NVDA.headline: Nvidia and Microsoft launch RTX Spark hardware and AI-agent software for Windows PCs
NVDA.why: Extends Nvidia's AI stack into consumer PCs, a new demand channel alongside data-center GPUs

AAPL.headline: Apple reportedly cuts iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max component orders ~15-20% on soft demand after price hike
AAPL.why: Suggests weaker-than-expected unit demand for the higher-priced Pro lineup entering the holiday quarter

AAPL.headline: Apple announces 'Welcome home' event for Oct 13 to unveil smart home hub, new HomePod mini, Apple TV
AAPL.why: Signals entry into a new smart-home hardware category with Siri AI at the core

AAPL.headline: EU weighs flat annual 'CORE' levy on big tech incl. Apple instead of targeted digital tax
AAPL.why: New EU revenue-based corporate levy would add a recurring cost and replaces a more combative digital-services-tax plan

AAPL.headline: Apple sets Q4 FY2026 earnings release for November 2
AAPL.why: Confirms reporting date for the quarter covering iPhone 18 Pro launch-week sales

MSFT.headline: Microsoft launches Microsoft-Decision-1, a fast low-cost AI model for scoring decisions instead of generating text
MSFT.why: New Foundry product line signals Microsoft pushing beyond chat-style LLMs into cheaper, faster enterprise decision-automation, a potential Azure AI revenue driver

MSFT.headline: US Labor Dept suspends Microsoft, Adobe and six outsourcing firms from PERM green card program
MSFT.why: Blocks Microsoft from certifying new H-1B/green-card sponsorships amid fraud allegations tied to its visa usage and layoffs

GOOGL.headline: Waymo closes $5B term loan, its first debt financing, after $16B equity round at $126B valuation
GOOGL.why: Shows Waymo funding robotaxi expansion via debt backed by its own IP rather than Alphabet capital, easing pressure on parent balance sheet

GOOGL.headline: TD Cowen raises Alphabet price target to $485 from $475, maintains bullish stance
GOOGL.why: Incremental analyst conviction ahead of Oct 28 Q3 earnings, among a cluster of Buy-rated target reiterations this week

GOOGL.headline: Google and Unity launch Playground platform with Unity Spark for AI-generated games
GOOGL.why: New AI monetization avenue in gaming/content creation, expanding Gemini's reach into a new consumer product category

GOOGL.headline: Google signs 20-year nuclear PPA with Constellation Energy, $4.3B in reactor upgrades
GOOGL.why: Locks in 3.59GW of power including 890MW nuclear for AI data centers, adding to Alphabet's AI infrastructure capex commitments

AMZN.headline: Judge rejects Amazon's bid to delay FTC antitrust monopoly trial
AMZN.why: Keeps litigation risk and timeline (trial set for March 2027) intact, no relief on regulatory overhang

AMZN.headline: Amazon unveils new Alexa tablet lineup with Alexa+ and Google Play Store access, replacing Fire brand
AMZN.why: New hardware category and a Google Play Store tie-up broaden device ecosystem and Alexa+ distribution

AMZN.headline: AWS raises reserved GPU capacity prices ~15%, 4th straight quarterly hike
AMZN.why: Shows AWS pricing power on scarce AI compute, supporting cloud margin/revenue outlook

AMZN.headline: Amazon lays off employees in Stores retail division, confirmed during Prime Big Deal Days
AMZN.why: Signals continued cost-cutting in core e-commerce even as holiday sales push begins

AMD.headline: AMD CEO Lisa Su meets Samsung, SK hynix in Seoul on HBM4 and foundry ties
AMD.why: Samsung confirmed as primary HBM4 supplier for AMD's Instinct MI455X and DDR5 for next-gen EPYC 'Venice'; foundry cooperation still exploratory, no deal signed

AMD.headline: Citi raises AMD price target to $800 from $575, keeps Buy
AMD.why: Analyst Atif Malik cites Meta's Muse AI agent running on AMD EPYC chips as driving a CPU market renaissance

AMD.headline: Mizuho lifts AMD price target to $705 from $580, Outperform
AMD.why: Cites an $80B agentic-AI-driven CPU market forecast as a tailwind for AMD server demand

AMD.headline: Stifel raises AMD price target to $700 from $635, Buy
AMD.why: Cites server-segment strength as a core driver of AMD's AI-era earnings growth

AVGO.headline: Broadcom in talks to arrange $30-50B+ private financing for OpenAI's custom 'Nexus' AI chips
AVGO.why: Signals scale of OpenAI chip program and shifts financing risk/exposure onto Broadcom-arranged credit facilities, similar to its Anthropic structure

AVGO.headline: Broadcom unveils Tomahawk 6, Tomahawk Ultra, Jericho4 switches and Thor NICs/CPO at OCP Summit
AVGO.why: New Ethernet switch and optics lineup targets scale-up/scale-out AI clusters, underpinning its AI networking revenue alongside custom accelerators

INTC.headline: Microsoft unveils Maia 300 AI chip, built on TSMC's 2nm process, not Intel
INTC.why: Marquee AI accelerator order went to TSMC, a setback for Intel Foundry's push to land flagship external customers

INTC.headline: Intel CEO Tan says Intel stays involved in Musk's Terafab as TSMC sublease talk swirls
INTC.why: Clarifies Intel won't be displaced from a major chip-fab venture after market speculation TSMC could take over

INTC.headline: Applied Materials and Intel expand collaboration on AI chipmaking tech
INTC.why: Deepens Intel's access to next-gen transistor, interconnect and Foveros packaging R&D needed to compete in AI chips

INTC.headline: Mizuho raises Intel price target to $114 from $92, keeps Neutral rating
INTC.why: Analyst cites stronger CPU demand tied to agentic AI applications, though rating stays Hold-equivalent

TSM.headline: TSMC Q3 revenue hits record NT$1.49tn (~$46.7B), up ~50% YoY, above top of guidance
TSM.why: Confirms demand strength ahead of Oct 15 earnings; beat implies upside to consensus estimates

TSM.headline: TSMC signs $2B deal for GlobalFoundries to make CoWoS silicon interposers in US from 2028
TSM.why: Adds a second, US-based interposer source to ease TSMC's sold-out CoWoS packaging bottleneck

TSM.headline: Barclays raises TSMC price target to $665 from $650, keeps Overweight/Buy
TSM.why: Analyst Simon Coles cites improved industry fundamentals ahead of Q3 results despite recent chip-sector selloff

ASML.headline: Samsung and SK Hynix accept ASML's 10% price hike on EUV/DUV replacement parts, effective Jan 2027
ASML.why: Rare across-the-board pricing power move boosts near-term Installed Base revenue outlook

ASML.headline: ASML CEO Fouquet says AI chip demand boom could extend beyond 2028; Broadcom's Tan flags financing as bottleneck
ASML.why: Extends visibility on demand duration but introduces financing/capital constraint as a new risk to the upgrade cycle

ASML.headline: ASML and Zeiss publish peer-reviewed paper on 'Hyper NA' EUV successor, ~10 years out
ASML.why: Signals next lithography generation beyond High NA is technically feasible, extending ASML's long-term moat narrative

ASML.headline: BofA and Barclays raise ASML price targets to €2,557 and €2,450 on higher ASPs/volumes
ASML.why: Sell-side lifts EUV/DUV pricing and unit forecasts ahead of Q3 print, reinforcing AI-driven demand thesis

MU.headline: MU falls ~4.5%, erasing ~$52B, as China's CXMT flags denser server DRAM design
MU.why: Threatens Micron's server-memory pricing power, where adjusted gross margin hit 87% last quarter

MU.headline: Micron board raises buyback authorization to $35.16B, largest ever
MU.why: Signals confidence in free cash flow generation and capital return capacity

MU.headline: DA Davidson raises MU price target to $3,000 from $2,100, Street-high
MU.why: Analyst Gil Luria argues market still underestimates AI-driven HBM demand/supply imbalance into 2027-28

MU.headline: Micron to pay Netlist $600M in 5-year patent license, settling all litigation
MU.why: Removes legal overhang and patent-infringement liability tied to Micron's memory chips

MRVL.headline: Bank of America raises Marvell price target to $400 from $365 on $80B mid-point sales outlook
MRVL.why: BofA models pro forma EPS above $32 by 2030 vs. consensus ~$18, reinforcing bullish re-rating after Investor Day

MRVL.headline: RBC Capital raises Marvell price target to $425 from $360, keeps Outperform
MRVL.why: Cites interconnect leadership and custom silicon progress following Investor Day, among the largest post-event target hikes

MRVL.headline: Marvell sets FY2031 revenue target of $70B-$90B, raises FY2028 outlook to ~$20B at Investor Day
MRVL.why: Management's long-range targets reset the growth narrative around AI data-center demand, driving sharp sell-side price target increases

9988.headline: BofA raises Alibaba price target to $178 from $175, calls earnings inflection underpriced
9988.why: Analyst Joyce Ju lifts cloud revenue growth forecast to 52% from 45% and cloud margin forecast to 12.9% from 11.6%, arguing the stock doesn't reflect the improvement

9988.headline: Jefferies lifts Alibaba price target to $192 from $190, keeps Buy/Top Pick
9988.why: Jefferies forecasts Alibaba cloud revenue growth above 50% YoY in FY2028, reinforcing the cloud re-rating thesis ahead of Dec 1 earnings

9988.headline: Citi raises Alibaba price target to $193 from $190, maintains Buy
9988.why: Analyst Alicia Yap models Sept-quarter cloud revenue up 52% YoY to RMB60.5bn and consolidated revenue growth of 8.2% YoY ahead of the Dec 1 print

0700.headline: Morgan Stanley cuts Tencent price target to HK$650 from HK$735, keeps Overweight
0700.why: Cites AI investment pressure cutting 2026-27 non-IFRS operating profit estimates by 6-7%, a read on near-term margin risk

0700.headline: Tencent launches ~$5B bond offering (USD and offshore yuan notes) mainly to fund AI capex
0700.why: Shows Tencent financing its AI buildout via debt rather than only cash flow, raising leverage to support capex

0700.headline: AI agent startup Manus raises $500M+ at ~$4B valuation with Tencent among investors
0700.why: Extends Tencent's strategic AI investment footprint following the collapse of Manus's Meta acquisition

0700.headline: DeepSeek nears $12B pre-IPO funding round backed by Tencent and CATL ahead of 2027 Shanghai listing
0700.why: Signals Tencent deepening its stake in a leading rival/partner AI model maker, adding to its AI investment portfolio exposure

3690.headline: SAMR holds public hearing on Meituan's Maiyatian stake deal, flags risk to competition in delivery and instant retail
3690.why: First-ever Chinese review of a sub-threshold platform merger; adverse outcome could force deal changes or block Meituan's delivery-aggregation consolidation

3690.headline: Meituan's National Day report shows consecutive-night hotel bookings up 31% YoY, long-haul travel orders up 25%
3690.why: Points to continued strength in the higher-margin in-store/hotel/travel segment during the Golden Week holiday

3690.headline: Keeta expands into 21 more Brazilian cities, reaching 32 total and 10m app downloads
3690.why: Shows overseas delivery expansion (a key growth/loss driver) accelerating again after a court struck down a rival's exclusivity clauses

9618.headline: JD.com set to win EU approval for $2.5bn Ceconomy takeover after revising remedies
9618.why: Clears a key regulatory hurdle for JD's largest European retail acquisition (85.2% of Ceconomy/MediaMarkt-Saturn); EU decision due by Nov 4

6181.headline: Laopu Gold runs its first-ever discount, cutting prices up to 20-33% during Golden Week
6181.why: First markdown since founding breaks the brand's never-discount pricing power narrative, though stores reported discounts didn't meaningfully lift volume
